This month, we’re focused on empowering teams to jam better together. Whether it’s a productive brainstorm or a well-run retro, these new features will help add more structure and personalization to your FigJam files, and bring your brightest ideas to life.

## [Structure and customize your jams](#structure-and-customize-your-jams)

From workshops to weekly team get-togethers, we want teams to be able to make FigJam their own. Now, you have even more flexibility, building on top of the updated [stamps, stickies, and font sizes](https://www.figma.com/blog/whats-new-in-figma-february-2022/)

we launched in February.

![A FigJam file showing two separate green boxes, indicating different sections.](data:image/png;base64,)![A FigJam file showing two separate green boxes, indicating different sections.](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/b4e02740adb5e6bd8c1455bd9b8d9c4cf0af4153-1378x507.png?rect=1,0,1377,507&w=804&h=296&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)

Sections in FigJam

Now, you can:

-   Organize your files with the ability to create [sections](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/articles/4939765379351-Organize-your-FigJam-board-with-sections)
-   Pick and choose between [more colors or add your own custom colors](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/articles/1500004291341) to stickies and shapes
-   [Make stickies proportional and consistent](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/articles/1500004414322) with the rest of the content in your file
-   [Customize and adjust font sizes](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/articles/1500004291281)—ideal for adding hierarchy and scale to titles and labels
-   Arrange objects and align things perfectly with snapping improvements
-   Lock or unlock multiple objects at once, with a single click

## [Bring more joy to your jams](#bring-more-joy-to-your-jams)

We’re making cursor chat more expressive, adding new sticker packs from popular artists, and bringing back one of your favorite [April Fun Day features](https://twitter.com/figma/status/1509916506242662403?s=20&t=tm0x2PtC_aCrXcItE0Q6pw).

### [Washi tape, now a permanent FigJam feature](#washi-tape-now-a-permanent-figjam-feature)

[Washi tape](https://www.figma.com/blog/figjam-washi-tape/)

is back, with dozens of newly designed tape options and the ability to upload your own patterns.

### [Sticker packs from popular artists](#sticker-packs-from-popular-artists)

We're excited to bring four new sticker packs to FigJam, designed by members of the Figma Community. Shout out to Jiro Bevis, [Diana Marmol](https://twitter.com/dianammarmol), [Rooney](https://twitter.com/heyrooneyhey), and [Fanny Luor](https://twitter.com/fannyluor) for the incredible work!

![Four stickers: 1) Says "stellar work" and has a sun with sunglasses; 2) says "slay" with four stars; 3) says "let's jam" with a creature playing drums; 4) has someone with sunglasses](data:image/png;base64,)![Four stickers: 1) Says "stellar work" and has a sun with sunglasses; 2) says "slay" with four stars; 3) says "let's jam" with a creature playing drums; 4) has someone with sunglasses](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/4841427b8fa61cb5cec9a260a7b8d25d76c5c0a0-1139x365.png?rect=2,0,1137,365&w=804&h=258&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)

New stickers in FigJam

### [More ways to express yourself with cursor chat](#more-ways-to-express-yourself-with-cursor-chat)

Cursor chat is getting more emotive. Now, when you type certain words, expressions, or use a bunch of exclamation points, your cursor will come alive for a few moments.

![Four cursor chats: 1) Says "slick"; 2) says "Happy birthday" with an image of a present; 3) says "omg!!"; 4) says "Fireeee" with image of fire](data:image/png;base64,)![Four cursor chats: 1) Says "slick"; 2) says "Happy birthday" with an image of a present; 3) says "omg!!"; 4) says "Fireeee" with image of fire](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/2a8ca0a5fd431d6f305527272a2a39d983df2772-1600x620.png?rect=1,0,1598,620&w=804&h=312&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)

Expressive cursor chats in FigJam

## [Stay in the flow with new Figma integrations](#stay-in-the-flow-with-new-figma-integrations)

### [Access Figma files directly in Notion](#access-figma-files-directly-in-notion)

[With Notion’s new link previews](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/articles/360046037373-Notion-and-Figma), you can now more easily share Figma and FigJam files within Notion pages—no additional authentication required.

![A screenshot of a Notion doc ](data:image/png;base64,)![A screenshot of a Notion doc ](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/e6942c9bea82705dde7fa94fc3869325d5436ed3-1600x900.png?w=804&h=452&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)

Figma link preview in Notion

### [Go from design to app with AWS Amplify Studio](#go-from-design-to-app-with-aws-amplify-studio)

AWS Amplify Studio is a visual interface that developers can use to turn [Figma design components into feature-rich, full-stack React apps](https://aws.amazon.com/amplify/studio/) faster–with no cloud or AWS expertise required.

![Figma design module on the left, and React code on the right](data:image/png;base64,)![Figma design module on the left, and React code on the right](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/431246436d334df4b5a5065a9743f32708f8fae1-1170x666.png?rect=1,0,1169,666&w=804&h=458&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)

Figma to React with AWS Amplify Studio

[Check out our API documentation](https://www.figma.com/developers/api) to get started with your own integrations.

For even more detailed improvements, make sure to check out the [release notes](https://releases.figma.com/). Plus, we’ll be sharing many more new features at Config, our annual conference. [Learn more and register here](https://config.figma.com/events/figma-config-2022/home).
